title: glosa equation registry row
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §8.1: one row per named equation/definition, registered ONCE at first use (Buckingham-trap guard: never re-derive an equation's identity silently). A second project reusing an equation adds itself to `used_in_projects` and creates a kg `derives_from`/`borrows` edge -- it never re-registers under a new id. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

allOf.description: external_first_publication is REQUIRED when borrowed_vs_derived_status is BORROWED or DERIVED_FROM_BORROWED_ANCHOR (template's own rule).
